title: ygjson sets
description: sets/sets.json: every set a print can belong to. YGOPRODeck's sets, plus the TCGplayer groups that are not one of them (the 2020 date reprints).

id.description: The slug of the YGOPRODeck set name, deduplicated with -2, -3 when two names slug alike.

code.description: The set prefix (LOB). Not unique: 142 prefixes are shared by several sets, so the id is the key.

type.description: The set's product line. The importers guess it from the name; import_yugipedia refines it from the Yugipedia infobox.

series.description: Yugipedia's series for the set (Core Booster, Mega-Pack...).

parent.description: The set this one hangs off: a sneak peek, special edition or promo names the booster it reprints, a date-reprint group the set it reprints.

era.description: The code of the era (sets/eras.json) whose window holds the release date; a child set without a date takes its parent's.

editions.description: The editions the set was printed in. A print overrides it with its own editions.

source.description: ygoprodeck: the set is on YGOPRODeck. tcgplayer: minted for a TCGplayer group YGOPRODeck lacks.

releaseDate.description: YGOPRODeck's tcg_date, else Yugipedia's North American or English release date.

keyArt.description: The set's art, hotlinked: YGOPRODeck's set_image with the YGOPRODeck set page as source, else YGOJSON's pack art with the Yugipedia page as source.

konamiDatabaseIds.description: Set ids on Konami's card database.
